Definition: from G5194; glassy, i.e. transparent:--of glass.
BiblicalUsage: In the New Testament, hyálinos is the word for of glass, glassy, transparent. In Revelation 4:6, the text says "And before the throne [there was] a sea of glass like unto crystal."
TheologicalSignificance: This one, hyálinos, I take at face value: of glass, glassy, transparent.
